# Rainbow Sanctuary

> Rainbow Sanctuary is a global community offering spiritual wellbeing experiences, conscious-development programs, family support, practitioner pathways, online gatherings, and in-person retreats. Its work is educational and experiential and does not replace medical or mental-health care.

## Start here

- [Home](https://rainbowsanctuary.life/): Overview and current invitations
- [About Rainbow Sanctuary](https://rainbowsanctuary.life/about): The platform, community, and co-founder Stephanie Wu
- [The Spiral Journey](https://rainbowsanctuary.life/spiral-journey): Four progressive levels of personal and conscious development
- [Online Group Healing](https://rainbowsanctuary.life/group-healing): Accessible guided Zoom sessions
- [Programs](https://rainbowsanctuary.life/programs): Focused adult workshops and learning programs
- [Children and Family](https://rainbowsanctuary.life/children-and-family): Programs for children, teens, and families
- [Practitioner Certification](https://rainbowsanctuary.life/practitioner-certification): Responsible practitioner pathways
- [Private Healing](https://rainbowsanctuary.life/private-healing): Application-led private spiritual wellbeing sessions
- [Events](https://rainbowsanctuary.life/events): Upcoming online sessions, gatherings, and retreats

## Current event

- [Awakening Your Inner Light Retreat 2026](https://rainbowsanctuary.life/awakening-your-inner-light-2026): Seven-day retreat in Bocas del Toro, Panama, 1–7 October 2026
